title: Layered consent and opt-in UX and records
summary: The layered, default-off, purpose-specific opt-in UX + consent records (data/schemas/avatar/consent_record): (A) custom_avatar_biometric, (B) avatar_cloud_sync, (C) per-share upload (highlight/summit/competition), (D) training. Each is a separate explicit screen (never bundled), writes an immutable record before the action, and is withdrawable in one tap. The 13+ age gate precedes consent.

acceptance_tests.test: Each purpose is a separate explicit opt-in that writes a schema-valid consent_record before any action in that purpose; no action proceeds without a granted record; withdrawal writes a granted:false record and completes within 30 days.

history.event: created under AUTH #044. Consent copy counsel-gated before ship (§5.5).

copy convention (AUTH #044 addendum): the create-flow + consent screens use 'avatar' ('Create your avatar') - the only user-facing use of the word; see DESIGN_SYSTEM section 9 + legal/BIPA_CONSENT.md.

notes: Records follow data/schemas/avatar/consent_record; consent copy in legal/BIPA_CONSENT.md (counsel sign-off before ship). Create/consent copy uses 'avatar' (the only user-facing use of the word; AUTH #044 addendum, DESIGN_SYSTEM section 9).
